The raw datasets used for this project were downloaded from the official sources (Mendeley Data for the ChatGPT perception survey, and the World Bank for the country income classification). These raw files have been added directly to the GitHub repository of this project. The Github repository can be found at the following link: \[https://github.com/klyfat2/Projet-data-chatgpt.git\]

```{r}
#| message: false
here::i_am("Projet-data-chatgpt.Rproj")
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(vroom)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
#| message: false

survey_data <- vroom(here("data", "survey dataset.csv"), 
                     delim = ";", 
                     locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"))
wb_data <- vroom(here("data", "World Bank Country and Lending Groups .csv"))

```

```{r}
#| message: false

survey_summary <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c("File", "Number of rows", "Number of columns", "Numeric variables", "Character variables", "Missing values (NA)"),
  Value = c("survey dataset.csv", 
            nrow(survey_data), 
            ncol(survey_data), 
            survey_data |> select(where(is.numeric)) |> ncol(), 
            survey_data |> select(where(is.character)) |> ncol(), 
            sum(is.na(survey_data)))
)

wb_summary <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c("File", "Number of rows", "Number of columns", "Numeric variables", "Character variables", "Missing values (NA)"),
  Value = c("World Bank Country and Lending Groups .csv", 
            nrow(wb_data), 
            ncol(wb_data), 
            wb_data |> select(where(is.numeric)) |> ncol(), 
            wb_data |> select(where(is.character)) |> ncol(), 
            sum(is.na(wb_data)))
)

survey_summary
wb_summary

```

## Data Cleaning 

### Gender
```{r}
survey = survey_data |>
  mutate( Q2 = Q2 |> 
            na_if(3) |>
            na_if(4)) |>
  rename(gender = Q2)
```

### Age

```{r}
survey = survey |> 
  mutate(Q3 = if_else(Q3 < 16 | Q3 > 50, NA, Q3)) |> 
  rename(age = Q3)
```

### Rename 

```{r}
survey = survey |> 
  rename(
    nationality = Q1,
    ChatGPT_user = Q13, 
     ChatGPT_version = Q14,
    frequency = Q15,
    ethic_policy = Q20
  )
```

```{r}
wb = wb_data |>
  filter(!is.na(Economy)) |>
  rename(country = Economy) |>
  mutate(country = recode_values(country, 
    "C\xf4te d\x92Ivoire" ~ "Cote d'Ivoire",
    "S\xe3o Tom\xe9 and Pr\xedncipe" ~ "Sao Tome and Príncipe",
    "T\xfcrkiye" ~ "Turkiye",
    default = country 
  ))
```

## Data Joining

### Key variable 

```{r}
survey <- survey |>
  mutate(country = survey_data$Q4)
```

```{r}
survey <- survey |> 
  mutate(country = case_match(country,
    "The Netherlands"          ~ "Netherlands",
    "Turkey"                   ~ "Türkiye",
    "Macedonia"                ~ "North Macedonia",
    "Antigua & Barbuda"        ~ "Antigua and Barbuda",
    "Bosnia & Herzegovina"     ~ "Bosnia and Herzegovina",
    "United States of America" ~ "United States",
    "Cote d’Ivoire"            ~ "Côte d’Ivoire",
    "Cape Verde"               ~ "Cabo Verde",
    "Taiwan"                   ~ "Taiwan, China",
    "The Philippines"          ~ "Philippines",
    "Bahamas"                  ~ "Bahamas, The",
    "Egypt"                    ~ "Egypt, Arab Rep.",
    "Russia"                   ~ "Russian Federation",
    "Gambia"                   ~ "Gambia, The",
    "Czech Republic"           ~ "Czechia",
    "Slovakia"                 ~ "Slovak Republic",
    "Iran"                     ~ "Iran, Islamic Rep.",
    "Palestinian State*"       ~ "West Bank and Gaza",
    "Korea South"              ~ "Korea, Rep.",
    "Korea North"              ~ "Korea, Dem. People's Rep.",
    "Vatican City (Holy See)"  ~ "Vatican", 
    "Other:"                   ~ NA_character_,
    .default = country 
  ))
```

```{r}
wb_data$country = wb_data$Economy
```

### Join 

```{r}
survey = survey|>
  left_join(wb_data, by = "country")
```
